feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence: iteration 0 (five 12 mm sensors at x -0.02 to +0.02 m, y 0.05 m, mass 0.8, wheel_radius 0.03, wheel_track 0.12) is still the best result at 52.28, with progress 0.138 (oval) and 0.148 (s-bend) and 1.0 to 2.0 line-loss events per run. Iterations 1 to 3 showed that widening to 16 mm sensors and moving them forward to y 0.03 m lowered progress without removing the single loss. Iteration 7 confirmed the baseline at 52.28. Iteration 6 raised oval progress (0.1446) but lowered s-bend progress (0.135) with wheel_radius 0.035 and wheel_track 0.16. Steering oscillation has stayed between 0.07 and 0.14, so the loss is a line dropout at a fixed point, not jitter. Decision rules for the next race: (1) If line_loss_events stays at 1.0 per run and progress holds at or above the iteration 7 values, the 8 mm footprint is safe. Keep it, and ask for per-track telemetry on where the loss occurs before making another geometry change. (2) If line loss rises above 1.0, or the slalom loss rises above 2.0, the 2 mm gaps between footprints are causing dropouts. Return to sensor_size 0.012 and test the forward offset y 0.06 m, which has not been tried and sits inside the contract range. (3) If progress falls below the baseline with no change in line loss, the footprint is not the problem, and the controller is the next suspect; return to sensor_size 0.012.
requested_changes: Set sensor_size to 0.008 m on the same five positions (x -0.02 to +0.02 m, y 0.05 m) with mass 0.8 kg, wheel_radius 0.03 m and wheel_track 0.12 m. Basis: iteration 7 baseline gave 1.0 line loss per run on oval and s-bend, and no earlier iteration has tested a footprint below 12 mm.

If line loss rises or dropouts appear, return sensor_size to 0.012 m and move sensor y from 0.05 to 0.06 m with the same x spacing. Basis: iteration 0 at y 0.05 m gave better progress than iteration 2 at y 0.03 m, so the forward offset is not yet tested beyond 0.05 m.

If line loss stays at 1.0 with the baseline sensing, test wheel_radius 0.035 m with wheel_track 0.12 m, changing only the radius. Basis: iteration 6 changed radius and track together, raised oval progress to 0.1446, and lowered s-bend progress to 0.135, so it is unclear which change caused each effect.
